{{Top}}
'''Hyperbarides''' were a group of so-called superheavy elements that were extremely rare throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], but were required for [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] technology.<ref name="Potm">''[[Planet of the Mists]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Hyperbarides were known to be as stable as more common elements, but they had certain special chemical and physical properties. They could withstand high [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]], levels of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and flux densities, which made them useful for many high-energy technologies.<ref name="Potm" />

Hyperbarides were cytotoxic minerals that were lethal to nearly any form of life based on carbon-oxygen physiology, similar to other heavy metals, but also served as a mutagen. The only known species resistant to hyperbarides were the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]], due to their evolution on a heavy-metal- and hyperbaride-rich world.<ref name="GSE">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

==Usage==
Hyperbarides could be synthesized from normal elements, but the process was very expensive, requiring high pressure and temperature and a lot of energy.

==History==
By the time of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], hyperbarides had been known for several centuries.<ref name="Potm" />

During an industrial accident in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], hyperbaride runoff was released among other industrial waste when [[Waste Canister Delivery Port 84-D-21]] in the [[Desrini District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] misfired.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_2.html|Garbage Launcher Misfire Kills 48; Closes Desrini}}</ref>

Normally the price of hyperbarides ranged around 2,200 credits per kilogram during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], though this varied according to Imperial price controls.<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>

The Galactic Empire had several [[Hyperbaride synthesis plant|synthesis plants]], but their locations were highly guarded military secrets. [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|One of them]] was on the planet of [[Marca/Legends|Marca]],<ref name="Potm" /> and another one was on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], but corporately controlled.<ref name="GSE" />

It was possible to [[Death/Legends|die]] of "hyperbaride poisoning." An Imperial dignitary died of such poisoning due to eating [[Clawcat]]s.<ref name="GSE" />

==Deposits==
Hyperbarides were extremely rare and could only be found on a few planets; even there, an occurrence of one part per quadrillion was considered abnormally high. Naturally existing hyperbarides came in compounds, such as [[ilinium trioxide]] or [[vintrium hydride]], which were less valuable than pure materials.<ref name="GSE" />

The world Goroth Prime had an unnaturally high concentration of hyperbarides, among other heavy metals, in its crust. This was not discovered until its devastation and rediscovery a few thousand years later.<ref name="GSE" />
